name: Trident of the Azarketis
text:
This +2 striking trident is made of golden metal, its handle carved with reliefs of waves and seashells. These tridents are often wielded by high-ranking azarketi soldiers in the ranks of alghollthu armies.

Activate—Force of the Sea 2 (manipulate)

Frequency once per day

---
Effect You cast a 5th-rank Hydraulic Torrent. The spell DC is 29.
